summary:
Software Engineer | Flutter Developer
Software Engineer with 4+ years of software development experience, including 3+ years building
cross-platform applications with Flutter and Dart. Delivered mobile applications for recharge, bill payments,
and SMS messaging, with REST API integration and deployment to Android, iOS, and web. Experienced across
the software development life cycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, design, implementation, system
testing, and deployment, with additional experience in academic teaching and graduation project supervision.
Open to relocation to Saudi Arabia (KSA).

experience.company: Al-Ertiqa Soft for Systems and Software - Yemen, Sana’a
experience.description:
Developed 2 cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart: a recharge and bill payment
application and an SMS messaging application.
Led development of the recharge and bill payment application, integrating REST APIs for secure
transactions and real-time balance updates.
Built and maintained the company website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Contributed to ASP.NET Core and SQL Server web projects and designed relational databases.
Collaborated in Agile/Scrum teams and used YouTrack for task management, sprint planning, and progress
tracking.

experience.company: University of Science and Technology - Sana’a
experience.description:
Developed a course timetabling system using AI-based scheduling algorithms, PostgreSQL, and ASP.NET
Core.
Performed system testing, debugging, and performance tuning.
Supervised multiple graduation projects and taught software engineering courses for 2 years.
